330	/// Semantic type of a prop. Rich enough to produce any output format.
331	/// Use match exhaustively — no `_` fallthrough in serializers.
332	#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
333	pub enum PropType {
334	    // ── Primitives
335	    /// `string`.
336	    String,
337	    /// `number`.
338	    Number,
339	    /// `boolean`; a `true | false` union is collapsed into this.
340	    Boolean,
341	    /// `null`.
342	    Null,
343	    /// `undefined`.
344	    Undefined,
345	    /// `any`.
346	    Any,
347	    /// `never`.
348	    Never,
349	    /// `unknown`.
350	    Unknown,
351	    /// `void`.
352	    Void,
353	
354	    // ── Literals
355	    /// A string literal type such as `"primary"`, holding the value without its quotes.
356	    StringLiteral(std::string::String),
357	    /// A number literal type such as `3`.
358	    NumberLiteral(f64),
359	    /// `true` or `false` as a type.
360	    BoolLiteral(bool),
361	
362	    // ── Composites
363	    /// `A | B`: the members in declaration order.
364	    Union(Vec<PropType>),
365	    /// `A & B`: the members in declaration order.
366	    Intersection(Vec<PropType>),
367	    /// `T[]` or `Array<T>`: the element type.
368	    Array(Box<PropType>),
369	    /// `[A, B]`: the element types in order.
370	    Tuple(Vec<PropType>),
371	    /// `readonly string[]` or `readonly [a, b]`: the array or tuple under the `readonly` operator.
372	    Readonly(Box<PropType>),
373	    /// An object type `{ a: string; b?: number }`: its members and index signatures, in declaration order.
374	    Object(Vec<ObjectField>),
375	
376	    // ── Named reference (post-resolution)
377	    /// A reference to a type by name that the resolver kept rather than expanding (a type from a dependency that was
378	    /// not loaded, or one that is better shown as a name), with its type arguments.
379	    Named {
380	        /// The name of the referenced type.
381	        name: TypeName,
382	        /// Generic args, already resolved to PropType
383	        args: Vec<PropType>,
384	    },
385	
386	    // ── React-specific terminals
387	    /// ReactNode, ReactElement, JSX.Element — all treated the same for docgen
388	    ReactNode,
389	    /// React.CSSProperties
390	    CssProperties,
391	    /// A function type: callbacks, render props and event handlers alike (`(value: number) => ReactNode`).
392	    Function {
393	        /// The function's own type parameters: `T` in `<T>(item: T) => ReactNode`.
394	        type_params: Vec<std::string::String>,
395	        /// The parameters in order.
396	        params: Vec<FunctionParam>,
397	        /// What the function returns, as written.
398	        return_type: Box<PropType>,
399	    },
400	    /// `Ref<T>`, `RefObject<T>`, `ForwardedRef<T>` and the other ref types React declares.
401	    Ref {
402	        /// The React type as written, without a `React.` prefix: `RefObject`, `ForwardedRef`, `RefCallback`.
403	        name: std::string::String,
404	        /// Inner element type if known
405	        element: Option<std::string::String>,
406	    },
407	    /// React.ElementType — component can render as any element
408	    /// Used for: `as?: ElementType`, `component?: ElementType`
409	    ElementType,
410	
411	    // ── HTML attribute inheritance
412	    /// All attributes of an HTML element, minus omitted keys.
413	    /// Produced when we see ComponentPropsWithoutRef<'button'> etc.
414	    HtmlAttributes {
415	        /// The HTML element whose attributes are inherited: `button` in `ComponentPropsWithoutRef<'button'>`.
416	        element: std::string::String,
417	        /// Attribute names left out of the element's set.
418	        omitted: Vec<std::string::String>,
419	    },
420	
421	    // ── Variant systems (statically resolved)
422	    /// Result of CvaVariantPropsHandler — the wrapper is fully dissolved.
423	    /// Each member is a string literal value.
424	    LiteralUnion {
425	        /// The string literal values, in declaration order.
426	        members: Vec<std::string::String>,
427	        /// true if this prop has a defaultVariant
428	        has_default: bool,
429	    },
430	
431	    // ── Known opaque patterns (cannot/should not be expanded)
432	    /// MUI SxProps, SystemStyleObject etc. — complex, not user-facing props
433	    SxProps,
434	
435	    // ── Unresolvable — graceful degradation
436	    /// A type the resolver gave up on, kept as written with the reason. Every one comes with a diagnostic that
437	    /// explains why (see [`OpaqueDetail`]).
438	    Opaque(OpaqueDetail),
439	}

484	impl PropType {
485	    /// Feed `hasher` everything that tells two types apart, so equal types hash equal. The resolver shares identical
486	    /// props by this hash (`ResolutionContext::share`).
487	    pub(crate) fn structural_hash<H: std::hash::Hasher>(&self, hasher: &mut H) {
488	        use std::hash::Hash;
489	        std::mem::discriminant(self).hash(hasher);
490	        let all = |hasher: &mut H, members: &[PropType]| {
491	            members.len().hash(hasher);
492	            members.iter().for_each(|member| member.structural_hash(hasher));
493	        };
494	        match self {
495	            PropType::String
496	            | PropType::Number
497	            | PropType::Boolean
498	            | PropType::Null
499	            | PropType::Undefined
500	            | PropType::Any
501	            | PropType::Never
502	            | PropType::Unknown
503	            | PropType::Void
504	            | PropType::ReactNode
505	            | PropType::CssProperties
506	            | PropType::ElementType
507	            | PropType::SxProps => {}
508	            PropType::StringLiteral(s) => s.hash(hasher),
509	            PropType::NumberLiteral(n) => n.to_bits().hash(hasher),
510	            PropType::BoolLiteral(b) => b.hash(hasher),
511	            PropType::Union(members) | PropType::Intersection(members) | PropType::Tuple(members) => {
512	                all(hasher, members)
513	            }
514	            PropType::Array(inner) | PropType::Readonly(inner) => inner.structural_hash(hasher),
515	            PropType::Object(fields) => {
516	                fields.len().hash(hasher);
517	                for field in fields {
518	                    field.name.hash(hasher);
519	                    field.required.hash(hasher);
520	                    field.readonly.hash(hasher);
521	                    if let Some(key) = &field.index_key {
522	                        key.structural_hash(hasher);
523	                    }
524	                    field.description.hash(hasher);
525	                    field.prop_type.structural_hash(hasher);
526	                }
527	            }
528	            PropType::Named { name, args } => {
529	                name.hash(hasher);
530	                all(hasher, args);
531	            }
532	            PropType::Function { type_params, params, return_type } => {
533	                type_params.hash(hasher);
534	                params.len().hash(hasher);
535	                for param in params {
536	                    param.name.hash(hasher);
537	                    param.optional.hash(hasher);
538	                    param.rest.hash(hasher);
539	                    param.param_type.structural_hash(hasher);
540	                }
541	                return_type.structural_hash(hasher);
542	            }
543	            PropType::Ref { name, element } => {
544	                name.hash(hasher);
545	                element.hash(hasher);
546	            }
547	            PropType::HtmlAttributes { element, omitted } => {
548	                element.hash(hasher);
549	                omitted.hash(hasher);
550	            }
551	            PropType::LiteralUnion { members, has_default } => {
552	                members.hash(hasher);
553	                has_default.hash(hasher);
554	            }
555	            // Rare, and its reason has no cheap hash of its own.
556	            PropType::Opaque(detail) => {
557	                detail.raw.hash(hasher);
558	                format!("{:?}", detail.reason).hash(hasher);
559	            }
560	        }
561	    }

563	    /// Whether a conditional, mapped or indexed access type the static resolver can't evaluate appears anywhere in this
564	    /// type, so its text would include that type's source.
565	    pub(crate) fn holds_unevaluated_type(&self) -> bool {
566	        self.holds_opaque_where(&|detail| {
567	            matches!(
568	                detail.reason(),
569	                OpaqueReason::ConditionalType | OpaqueReason::MappedType | OpaqueReason::IndexedAccess { .. }
570	            )
571	        })
572	    }
573	
574	    /// Whether any opaque type, whatever the reason, appears anywhere in this type.
575	    pub(crate) fn holds_opaque(&self) -> bool {
576	        self.holds_opaque_where(&|_| true)
577	    }
578	
579	    fn holds_opaque_where(&self, test: &dyn Fn(&OpaqueDetail) -> bool) -> bool {
580	        match self {
581	            PropType::Opaque(detail) => test(detail),
582	            PropType::Union(members) | PropType::Intersection(members) | PropType::Tuple(members) => {
583	                members.iter().any(|member| member.holds_opaque_where(test))
584	            }
585	            PropType::Array(inner) | PropType::Readonly(inner) => inner.holds_opaque_where(test),
586	            PropType::Object(fields) => fields.iter().any(|f| {
587	                f.prop_type.holds_opaque_where(test)
588	                    || f.index_key.as_ref().is_some_and(|key| key.holds_opaque_where(test))
589	            }),
590	            PropType::Named { args, .. } => args.iter().any(|arg| arg.holds_opaque_where(test)),
591	            PropType::Function { params, return_type, .. } => {
592	                params.iter().any(|p| p.param_type.holds_opaque_where(test)) || return_type.holds_opaque_where(test)
593	            }
594	            PropType::String
595	            | PropType::Number
596	            | PropType::Boolean
597	            | PropType::Null
598	            | PropType::Undefined
599	            | PropType::Any
600	            | PropType::Never
601	            | PropType::Unknown
602	            | PropType::Void
603	            | PropType::StringLiteral(_)
604	            | PropType::NumberLiteral(_)
605	            | PropType::BoolLiteral(_)
606	            | PropType::ReactNode
607	            | PropType::CssProperties
608	            | PropType::Ref { .. }
609	            | PropType::ElementType
610	            | PropType::HtmlAttributes { .. }
611	            | PropType::LiteralUnion { .. }
612	            | PropType::SxProps => false,
613	        }
614	    }
615	
616	    /// True if this type offers string or number options, which RDT output writes as an `enum` so Storybook shows the
617	    /// options as a radio: a union of string and number literals, or a single one. A union that also has a boolean
618	    /// member is an enum only when Storybook cannot read it from its type name (see `reads_as_json_options`), because
619	    /// the enum shape turns `true` into the string "true". A union with no members, or only booleans, has nothing to
620	    /// offer.
621	    pub fn is_literal_union(&self) -> bool {
622	        let is_option = |m: &PropType| matches!(m, PropType::StringLiteral(_) | PropType::NumberLiteral(_));
623	        match self {
624	            PropType::Union(members) => {
625	                let is_literal = |m: &PropType| is_option(m) || matches!(m, PropType::BoolLiteral(_));
626	                members.iter().any(is_option) && members.iter().all(is_literal) && !self.reads_as_json_options()
627	            }
628	            PropType::LiteralUnion { members, .. } => !members.is_empty(),
629	            single => is_option(single),
630	        }
631	    }
632	
633	    /// True for a union with a boolean member whose type name Storybook reads whole: it splits the name at each `|` and
634	    /// parses every part as JSON, which gives `true` as a real boolean. That holds only while every member's source
635	    /// text is one JSON value that parses back to the member and holds no `|`. A string with a `|`, a `"` or a `\`
636	    /// does not, and the union is then an `enum` so that no option is lost.
637	    fn reads_as_json_options(&self) -> bool {
638	        let PropType::Union(members) = self else { return false };
639	        members.iter().any(|m| matches!(m, PropType::BoolLiteral(_)))
640	            && members.iter().all(|m| match m {
641	                PropType::StringLiteral(s) => {
642	                    !s.contains('|')
643	                        && serde_json::from_str::<std::string::String>(&m.raw_string()).is_ok_and(|parsed| parsed == *s)
644	                }
645	                PropType::NumberLiteral(_) | PropType::BoolLiteral(_) => true,
646	                _ => false,
647	            })
648	    }

650	    /// Raw type string for display (e.g. in RDT PropItemType.raw)
651	    pub fn raw_string(&self) -> std::string::String {
652	        match self {
653	            PropType::String => "string".into(),
654	            PropType::Number => "number".into(),
655	            PropType::Boolean => "boolean".into(),
656	            PropType::Null => "null".into(),
657	            PropType::Undefined => "undefined".into(),
658	            PropType::Any => "any".into(),
659	            PropType::Never => "never".into(),
660	            PropType::Unknown => "unknown".into(),
661	            PropType::Void => "void".into(),
662	            PropType::StringLiteral(s) => format!("\"{}\"", s),
663	            PropType::NumberLiteral(n) => n.to_string(),
664	            PropType::BoolLiteral(b) => b.to_string(),
665	            PropType::Union(members) => {
666	                members.iter().map(|m| m.operand_string(Precedence::Union)).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" | ")
667	            }
668	            PropType::Intersection(members) => {
669	                members.iter().map(|m| m.operand_string(Precedence::Intersection)).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" & ")
670	            }
671	            PropType::Array(inner) => format!("{}[]", inner.operand_string(Precedence::Array)),
672	            PropType::Readonly(inner) => format!("readonly {}", inner.operand_string(Precedence::Array)),
673	            PropType::Tuple(members) => {
674	                format!("[{}]", members.iter().map(|m| m.raw_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", "))
675	            }
676	            PropType::Object(fields) => {
677	                let fields_str = fields
678	                    .iter()
679	                    .map(|f| {
680	                        let readonly = if f.readonly { "readonly " } else { "" };
681	                        if let Some(key) = &f.index_key {
682	                            return format!(
683	                                "{readonly}[{}: {}]: {}",
684	                                f.name,
685	                                key.raw_string(),
686	                                f.prop_type.raw_string()
687	                            );
688	                        }
689	                        let name = if is_valid_identifier(&f.name) { f.name.clone() } else { format!("'{}'", f.name) };
690	                        let optional = if f.required { "" } else { "?" };
691	                        format!("{readonly}{}{}: {}", name, optional, f.prop_type.raw_string())
692	                    })
693	                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
694	                    .join("; ");
695	                format!("{{ {} }}", fields_str)
696	            }
697	            PropType::LiteralUnion { members, .. } => {
698	                members.iter().map(|m| format!(r#""{}""#, m)).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" | ")
699	            }
700	            PropType::Named { name, args } if args.is_empty() => name.to_string(),
701	            PropType::Named { name, args } => {
702	                let args_str = args.iter().map(|a| a.raw_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", ");
703	                format!("{}<{}>", name, args_str)
704	            }
705	            PropType::ReactNode => "ReactNode".into(),
706	            PropType::CssProperties => "CSSProperties".into(),
707	            PropType::Function { type_params, params, return_type } => {
708	                let type_params = if type_params.is_empty() {
709	                    std::string::String::new()
710	                } else {
711	                    format!("<{}>", type_params.join(", "))
712	                };
713	                let params = params.iter().enumerate().map(|(i, p)| p.signature(i)).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", ");
714	                format!("{type_params}({params}) => {}", return_type.raw_string())
715	            }
716	            PropType::Ref { name, element: Some(e) } => format!("{name}<{e}>"),
717	            PropType::Ref { name, element: None } => format!("{name}<unknown>"),
718	            PropType::ElementType => "ElementType".into(),
719	            PropType::HtmlAttributes { element, .. } => {
720	                format!("{}HTMLAttributes", element_to_type_name(element))
721	            }

749	/// Streams each variant as a map with `kind` first, then its fields in a fixed order. Building a `serde_json::Value`
750	/// per node first made serialization the largest cost of a run at scale, and left the key order to whether a
751	/// dependency happened to enable serde_json's `preserve_order`.
752	impl serde::Serialize for PropType {
753	    fn serialize<S: serde::Serializer>(&self, serializer: S) -> Result<S::Ok, S::Error> {
754	        use serde::ser::SerializeMap;
755	
756	        let mut map = serializer.serialize_map(None)?;
757	        let unit_kind: Option<&str> = match self {
758	            PropType::String => Some("string"),
759	            PropType::Number => Some("number"),
760	            PropType::Boolean => Some("boolean"),
761	            PropType::Null => Some("null"),
762	            PropType::Undefined => Some("undefined"),
763	            PropType::Any => Some("any"),
764	            PropType::Never => Some("never"),
765	            PropType::Unknown => Some("unknown"),
766	            PropType::Void => Some("void"),
767	            PropType::ReactNode => Some("reactNode"),
768	            PropType::CssProperties => Some("cssProperties"),
769	            PropType::ElementType => Some("elementType"),
770	            PropType::SxProps => Some("sxProps"),
771	            _ => None,
772	        };
773	        if let Some(kind) = unit_kind {
774	            map.serialize_entry("kind", kind)?;
775	            return map.end();
776	        }
777	        match self {
778	            // Newtype/tuple variants get a real field name instead of a positional "0" key.
779	            PropType::StringLiteral(value) => {
780	                map.serialize_entry("kind", "stringLiteral")?;
781	                map.serialize_entry("value", value)?;
782	            }
783	            PropType::NumberLiteral(n) => {
784	                map.serialize_entry("kind", "numberLiteral")?;
785	                // JSON numbers cannot hold NaN or Infinity (serde_json would write `null`, which reads back as 0), so
786	                // those are tagged as strings; see `from_tagged_value`.
787	                if n.is_finite() {
788	                    map.serialize_entry("value", n)?;
789	                } else if n.is_nan() {
790	                    map.serialize_entry("value", "NaN")?;
791	                } else if *n > 0.0 {
792	                    map.serialize_entry("value", "Infinity")?;
793	                } else {
794	                    map.serialize_entry("value", "-Infinity")?;
795	                }
796	            }
797	            PropType::BoolLiteral(value) => {
798	                map.serialize_entry("kind", "boolLiteral")?;
799	                map.serialize_entry("value", value)?;
800	            }
801	            PropType::Union(members) => {
802	                map.serialize_entry("kind", "union")?;
803	                map.serialize_entry("members", members)?;
804	            }
805	            PropType::Intersection(members) => {
806	                map.serialize_entry("kind", "intersection")?;
807	                map.serialize_entry("members", members)?;
808	            }
809	            PropType::Array(inner) => {
810	                map.serialize_entry("kind", "array")?;
811	                map.serialize_entry("element", inner)?;
812	            }
813	            PropType::Tuple(members) => {
814	                map.serialize_entry("kind", "tuple")?;
815	                map.serialize_entry("elements", members)?;
816	            }
817	            PropType::Readonly(inner) => {
818	                map.serialize_entry("kind", "readonly")?;
819	                map.serialize_entry("element", inner)?;
820	            }
821	            PropType::Object(fields) => {
822	                map.serialize_entry("kind", "object")?;
823	                map.serialize_entry("fields", &WireFields(fields))?;
824	            }
825	            // Struct variants: fields merge directly with kind.
826	            PropType::Named { name, args } => {
827	                map.serialize_entry("kind", "named")?;
828	                map.serialize_entry("name", name.as_str())?;
829	                map.serialize_entry("args", args)?;
830	            }
831	            PropType::Function { type_params, params, return_type } => {
832	                map.serialize_entry("kind", "function")?;
833	                map.serialize_entry("typeParams", type_params)?;
834	                map.serialize_entry("params", params)?;
835	                map.serialize_entry("returnType", return_type)?;
836	            }
837	            PropType::Ref { name, element } => {
838	                map.serialize_entry("kind", "ref")?;
839	                map.serialize_entry("name", name)?;
840	                map.serialize_entry("element", element)?;
841	            }
842	            PropType::HtmlAttributes { element, omitted } => {
843	                map.serialize_entry("kind", "htmlAttributes")?;
844	                map.serialize_entry("element", element)?;
845	                map.serialize_entry("omitted", omitted)?;
846	            }
847	            PropType::LiteralUnion { members, has_default } => {
848	                map.serialize_entry("kind", "literalUnion")?;
849	                map.serialize_entry("members", members)?;
850	                map.serialize_entry("hasDefault", has_default)?;
851	            }
852	            PropType::Opaque(OpaqueDetail { raw, reason }) => {
853	                map.serialize_entry("kind", "opaque")?;
854	                map.serialize_entry("raw", raw)?;
855	                map.serialize_entry("reason", &WireReason(reason))?;
856	            }
857	            _ => {}
858	        }
859	        map.end()
860	    }
861	}

872	            fn serialize<S: serde::Serializer>(&self, serializer: S) -> Result<S::Ok, S::Error> {

1212	    /// The kinds of reason behind the `opaque` members of this type, each once, in the order they occur: what the
1213	    /// resolver could not evaluate. Empty when nothing in the type is `opaque`. A name left as an unexpanded
1214	    /// reference is not `opaque` and is not listed; its diagnostic says so.
1215	    pub fn degraded_by(&self) -> Vec<&'static str> {
1216	        fn collect(ty: &PropType, kinds: &mut Vec<&'static str>) {
1217	            match ty {
1218	                PropType::Opaque(detail) => {
1219	                    let kind = detail.reason().kind();
1220	                    if !kinds.contains(&kind) {
1221	                        kinds.push(kind);
1222	                    }
1223	                }
1224	                PropType::Union(members) | PropType::Intersection(members) | PropType::Tuple(members) => {
1225	                    members.iter().for_each(|member| collect(member, kinds));
1226	                }
1227	                PropType::Array(inner) | PropType::Readonly(inner) => collect(inner, kinds),
1228	                PropType::Object(fields) => fields.iter().for_each(|field| {
1229	                    // The key of an index signature (`[k: `data-${string}`]: T`) is part of the type too.
1230	                    if let Some(key) = &field.index_key {
1231	                        collect(key, kinds);
1232	                    }
1233	                    collect(&field.prop_type, kinds);
1234	                }),
1235	                PropType::Named { args, .. } => args.iter().for_each(|arg| collect(arg, kinds)),
1236	                PropType::Function { params, return_type, .. } => {
1237	                    params.iter().for_each(|param| collect(&param.param_type, kinds));
1238	                    collect(return_type, kinds);
1239	                }
1240	                PropType::String
1241	                | PropType::Number
1242	                | PropType::Boolean
1243	                | PropType::Null
1244	                | PropType::Undefined
1245	                | PropType::Any
1246	                | PropType::Never
1247	                | PropType::Unknown
1248	                | PropType::Void
1249	                | PropType::StringLiteral(_)
1250	                | PropType::NumberLiteral(_)
1251	                | PropType::BoolLiteral(_)
1252	                | PropType::ReactNode
1253	                | PropType::CssProperties
1254	                | PropType::Ref { .. }
1255	                | PropType::ElementType
1256	                | PropType::HtmlAttributes { .. }
1257	                | PropType::LiteralUnion { .. }
1258	                | PropType::SxProps => {}
1259	            }
1260	        }
1261	        let mut kinds = Vec::new();
1262	        collect(self, &mut kinds);
1263	        kinds
1264	    }
1265	}

1267	/// One parameter of a [`PropType::Function`].
1268	#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
1269	pub struct FunctionParam {
1270	    /// `None` for a destructured parameter, which has no single name.
1271	    pub name: Option<std::string::String>,
1272	    /// The parameter's type; serialized as `type`.
1273	    #[serde(rename = "type")]
1274	    pub param_type: PropType,
1275	    /// The parameter is written `name?: T`.
1276	    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "std::ops::Not::not")]
1277	    pub optional: bool,
1278	    /// The parameter is the rest parameter `...name: T[]`; its `type` is the array type as written.
1279	    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "std::ops::Not::not")]
1280	    pub rest: bool,
1281	}
1282	
1283	impl FunctionParam {
1284	    /// A required parameter.
1285	    pub fn new(name: Option<std::string::String>, param_type: PropType) -> Self {
1286	        Self { name, param_type, optional: false, rest: false }
1287	    }
1288	
1289	    /// The parameter as TypeScript prints it, with its `...` and `?`: `...rest: number[]`, `a?: string`.
1290	    fn signature(&self, index: usize) -> std::string::String {
1291	        let (prefix, marker) = (if self.rest { "..." } else { "" }, if self.optional { "?" } else { "" });
1292	        match &self.name {
1293	            Some(name) => format!("{prefix}{name}{marker}: {}", self.param_type.raw_string()),
1294	            // A destructured parameter has no name; TypeScript prints it as `__0`, `__1`, ...
1295	            None => format!("{prefix}__{index}{marker}: {}", self.param_type.raw_string()),
1296	        }
1297	    }
1298	}

1	//! Raw AST-level types produced by the extractor (Phase 0-2).
2	//! These are the extractor's output and the resolver's input.

4	use camino::{Utf8Path, Utf8PathBuf};

12	// ─── Type Aliases ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
13	
14	/// Compact string used for names, type strings — avoids heap alloc under 24 bytes.
15	pub type TypeName = CompactString;
16	
17	/// The name the extractor gives the alias it synthesizes for an inline props type (`function Card(props: { title: string })`),
18	/// the `index`th alias of its file. Both ends of the convention are here: `is_synthesized_alias` is how the resolver
19	/// tells such an alias, the component's own, from a declared one.
20	pub fn synthesized_alias_name(index: usize) -> String {
21	    format!("__anon_{index}")
22	}
23	
24	/// Whether `name` is the name of an alias the extractor synthesized for an inline props type.
25	pub fn is_synthesized_alias(name: &str) -> bool {
26	    name.starts_with("__anon_")
27	}

29	/// The key variable the resolver makes up for the mapped type a `Record` stands for. It is not an identifier, so no
30	/// user type can be named it, and the printer shows it as a variable that its value does not use.
31	pub const MADE_UP_KEY_VARIABLE: &str = "Record key";

33	// ─── ParamKind ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
34	
35	/// How a function parameter is declared: `a`, `a?` or `...a`.
36	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Default)]
37	pub enum ParamKind {
38	    /// `a`: the caller must pass it.
39	    #[default]
40	    Required,
41	    /// `a?`: the caller may leave it out.
42	    Optional,
43	    /// `...a`: it collects the remaining arguments, so its type is an array.
44	    Rest,
45	}
46	
47	impl ParamKind {
48	    /// The kind of a parameter that is `optional` (`a?`) or the `rest` parameter (`...a`).
49	    pub fn new(optional: bool, rest: bool) -> Self {
50	        match (rest, optional) {
51	            (true, _) => Self::Rest,
52	            (false, true) => Self::Optional,
53	            (false, false) => Self::Required,
54	        }
55	    }
56	
57	    /// Source text before the name: `...` for a rest parameter.
58	    pub(crate) fn prefix(self) -> &'static str {
59	        if self == Self::Rest { "..." } else { "" }
60	    }
61	
62	    /// Source text after the name: `?` for an optional parameter.
63	    pub(crate) fn marker(self) -> &'static str {
64	        if self == Self::Optional { "?" } else { "" }
65	    }
66	
67	    pub(crate) fn code(self) -> u8 {
68	        match self {
69	            Self::Required => 0,
70	            Self::Optional => 1,
71	            Self::Rest => 2,
72	        }
73	    }
74	
75	    pub(crate) fn from_code(code: u64) -> Self {
76	        match code {
77	            1 => Self::Optional,
78	            2 => Self::Rest,
79	            _ => Self::Required,
80	        }
81	    }
82	}

84	// ─── CollectedType ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
85	
86	/// A structured representation of a TypeScript type as collected from the AST.
87	/// This is the extractor's output — NOT yet resolved to a semantic PropType.
88	/// The resolver pattern-matches on this to produce PropType.
89	#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
90	pub enum CollectedType {
91	    // ── Primitives
92	    /// `string`.
93	    String,
94	    /// `number`.
95	    Number,
96	    /// `boolean`.
97	    Boolean,
98	    /// `null`.
99	    Null,
100	    /// `undefined`.
101	    Undefined,
102	    /// `any`.
103	    Any,
104	    /// `never`.
105	    Never,
106	    /// `unknown`.
107	    Unknown,
108	    /// `void`.
109	    Void,
110	    /// `bigint`.
111	    BigInt,
112	    /// `symbol`.
113	    Symbol,
114	
115	    // ── Literals
116	    /// A string literal type such as `"primary"`.
117	    StringLiteral(CompactString),
118	    /// A number literal type such as `3`.
119	    NumberLiteral(f64),
120	    /// `true` or `false` as a type.
121	    BoolLiteral(bool),
122	
123	    // ── Structural
124	    /// `A | B`: the members in declaration order.
125	    Union(Vec<CollectedType>),
126	    /// `A & B`: the members in declaration order.
127	    Intersection(Vec<CollectedType>),
128	    /// `T[]` or `Array<T>`: the element type.
129	    Array(Box<CollectedType>),
130	    /// `[A, B]`: the element types in order.
131	    Tuple(Vec<CollectedType>),
132	    /// `readonly T[]` or `readonly [A, B]`: the operand under the `readonly` operator.
133	    Readonly(Box<CollectedType>),
134	    /// An object type `{ a: string }`: its members and index signatures.
135	    Object(Vec<CollectedObjectField>),
136	
137	    // ── Named type reference (possibly generic, possibly not yet resolved)
138	    /// A reference to a type by name, with its type arguments. The resolver looks the name up; until then it is only
139	    /// a name.
140	    Named {
141	        /// The referenced type's name as written, possibly dotted (`React.ReactNode`).
142	        name: CompactString,
143	        /// The type arguments in order, empty for a name with none.
144	        args: Vec<CollectedType>,
145	    },
146	
147	    // ── `typeof X` — reference to the type of a value
148	    /// `typeof X`: the type of the value `X`. `X` is a name, possibly dotted.
149	    TypeOf(CompactString),
150	
151	    // ── `keyof X` — the union of X's own key names. Fully resolved when
152	    // consumed by `Omit`'s key argument (`CollectedTypeAlias::Omit::keys`
153	    // resolves X as a props chain and reads its field names), and standalone
154	    // when X is `typeof` a `const` object literal; any other standalone use
155	    // degrades to `PropType::Opaque` since we don't (yet) have a general
156	    // type-to-key-names resolver outside the chain machinery.
157	    /// `keyof X`: the union of `X`'s own key names.
158	    KeyOf(Box<CollectedType>),
159	
160	    // ── Resolver-internal only (the extractor never produces this): pins `inner`
161	    // to the file it was written in. TypeScript resolves a generic alias's type
162	    // *arguments* in the caller's scope, not the callee's — e.g. in
163	    // `type SelectRootProps<T> = Assign<HTMLProps<'div'>, SelectRootBaseProps<T>>`,
164	    // `SelectRootBaseProps` must resolve relative to the file declaring
165	    // `SelectRootProps`, even though `Assign`'s own body (`Omit<T, keyof U> & U`)
166	    // lives in a different file. Every `CollectedType` the resolver's generic-alias
167	    // substitution (resolver/substitute.rs) splices into a callee's body gets
168	    // wrapped in this so later name lookups switch back to the correct file.
169	    /// Resolver-internal; the extractor never produces it. A type argument pinned to the file it was written in, so a
170	    /// name inside it resolves relative to that file after a generic alias substitutes it into another file's body.
171	    AtFile {
172	        /// The file the wrapped type was written in.
173	        file: Utf8PathBuf,
174	        /// The wrapped type.
175	        inner: Box<CollectedType>,
176	    },
177	
178	    // ── Indexed access: Type["key"] or Type[K]
179	    /// An indexed access type: `Type["key"]` or `Type[K]`.
180	    IndexedAccess {
181	        /// The type being indexed (`Type`).
182	        obj: Box<CollectedType>,
183	        /// The index (`"key"` or `K`).
184	        key: Box<CollectedType>,
185	    },
186	
187	    // ── Template literal: `compact-${Size}` → parts = [Str("compact-"), Named("Size", [])]
188	    /// A template literal type: the parts in order, string pieces as [`CollectedType::StringLiteral`] and the
189	    /// `${...}` holes as the types they hold.
190	    TemplateLiteral(Vec<CollectedType>),
191	
192	    // ── Function type: (props: P) => ReactNode
193	    /// A function type: `(props: P) => ReactNode`.
194	    Function {
195	        /// The function's own type parameters (`<T>(item: T) => ReactNode`), in scope in its parameters and return type.
196	        type_params: Vec<CompactString>,
197	        /// The parameter types in order.
198	        params: Vec<CollectedType>,
199	        /// Source parameter names, parallel to `params` (same length). `None` for
200	        /// a given index when that parameter has no simple identifier binding
201	        /// (e.g. destructured) or the caller didn't capture one.
202	        param_names: Vec<Option<CompactString>>,
203	        /// Whether each parameter is required, optional (`a?`) or the rest parameter (`...a`), parallel to `params`.
204	        /// Shorter than `params` (or empty, as an old cache entry or a hand-built type is) means required.
205	        param_kinds: Vec<ParamKind>,
206	        /// What the function returns.
207	        return_type: Box<CollectedType>,
208	    },
209	
210	    // ── Conditional: T extends U ? X : Y — cannot resolve statically
211	    /// A conditional type `T extends U ? X : Y`.
212	    Conditional {
213	        /// The checked type (`T`).
214	        check: Box<CollectedType>,
215	        /// The type it is tested against (`U`).
216	        extends_type: Box<CollectedType>,
217	        /// The result when the test holds (`X`).
218	        true_type: Box<CollectedType>,
219	        /// The result when it does not (`Y`).
220	        false_type: Box<CollectedType>,
221	    },
222	
223	    // ── Mapped: { [K in Keys]: Value } — expanded as a props base when its keys are known (`resolver::evaluate`)
224	    /// A mapped type `{ [K in Keys]: Value }`.
225	    Mapped {
226	        /// The key variable (`K`), which `value_type` refers to.
227	        param: CompactString,
228	        /// The keys the variable ranges over (`Keys`).
229	        key_type: Box<CollectedType>,
230	        /// The type each key maps to (`Value`).
231	        value_type: Box<CollectedType>,
232	        /// `?` or `+?` (`Some(true)`), `-?` (`Some(false)`), or no modifier, which keeps each key's own optionality.
233	        optional: Option<bool>,
234	    },
235	
236	    // ── Fallback for syntax we don't recognise
237	    /// A type the extractor has no structural form for, kept as its source text.
238	    Raw(std::string::String),
239	}

241	impl CollectedType {
242	    /// Feed `hasher` everything that tells two types apart, without building their text: a cycle or cache key made of
243	    /// this is a few bytes where the debug text of a long union is kilobytes.
244	    pub fn structural_hash<H: std::hash::Hasher>(&self, hasher: &mut H) {
245	        use std::hash::Hash;
246	        std::mem::discriminant(self).hash(hasher);
247	        let all = |hasher: &mut H, members: &[CollectedType]| {
248	            members.len().hash(hasher);
249	            members.iter().for_each(|member| member.structural_hash(hasher));
250	        };
251	        match self {
252	            CollectedType::String
253	            | CollectedType::Number
254	            | CollectedType::Boolean
255	            | CollectedType::Null
256	            | CollectedType::Undefined
257	            | CollectedType::Any
258	            | CollectedType::Never
259	            | CollectedType::Unknown
260	            | CollectedType::Void
261	            | CollectedType::BigInt
262	            | CollectedType::Symbol => {}
263	            CollectedType::StringLiteral(s) | CollectedType::TypeOf(s) => s.hash(hasher),
264	            CollectedType::NumberLiteral(n) => n.to_bits().hash(hasher),
265	            CollectedType::BoolLiteral(b) => b.hash(hasher),
266	            CollectedType::Union(members)
267	            | CollectedType::Intersection(members)
268	            | CollectedType::Tuple(members)
269	            | CollectedType::TemplateLiteral(members) => all(hasher, members),
270	            CollectedType::Array(inner) | CollectedType::Readonly(inner) | CollectedType::KeyOf(inner) => {
271	                inner.structural_hash(hasher)
272	            }
273	            CollectedType::Object(fields) => {
274	                fields.len().hash(hasher);
275	                for field in fields {
276	                    field.name.hash(hasher);
277	                    field.required.hash(hasher);
278	                    field.readonly.hash(hasher);
279	                    if let Some(key) = &field.index_key {
280	                        key.structural_hash(hasher);
281	                    }
282	                    field.collected_type.structural_hash(hasher);
283	                }
284	            }
285	            CollectedType::Named { name, args } => {
286	                name.hash(hasher);
287	                all(hasher, args);
288	            }
289	            CollectedType::AtFile { file, inner } => {
290	                file.hash(hasher);
291	                inner.structural_hash(hasher);
292	            }
293	            CollectedType::IndexedAccess { obj, key } => {
294	                obj.structural_hash(hasher);
295	                key.structural_hash(hasher);
296	            }
297	            CollectedType::Function { type_params, params, param_names, param_kinds, return_type } => {
298	                type_params.hash(hasher);
299	                all(hasher, params);
300	                param_names.hash(hasher);
301	                param_kinds.hash(hasher);
302	                return_type.structural_hash(hasher);
303	            }
304	            CollectedType::Conditional { check, extends_type, true_type, false_type } => {
305	                for part in [check, extends_type, true_type, false_type] {
306	                    part.structural_hash(hasher);
307	                }
308	            }
309	            CollectedType::Mapped { param, key_type, value_type, optional } => {
310	                param.hash(hasher);
311	                key_type.structural_hash(hasher);
312	                value_type.structural_hash(hasher);
313	                optional.hash(hasher);
314	            }
315	            CollectedType::Raw(s) => s.hash(hasher),
316	        }
317	    }
318	
319	    /// Produce a raw string representation for diagnostics and fallback display.
320	    pub fn to_raw_string(&self) -> std::string::String {
321	        match self {
322	            CollectedType::String => "string".into(),
323	            CollectedType::Number => "number".into(),
324	            CollectedType::Boolean => "boolean".into(),
325	            CollectedType::Null => "null".into(),
326	            CollectedType::Undefined => "undefined".into(),
327	            CollectedType::Any => "any".into(),
328	            CollectedType::Never => "never".into(),
329	            CollectedType::Unknown => "unknown".into(),
330	            CollectedType::Void => "void".into(),
331	            CollectedType::BigInt => "bigint".into(),
332	            CollectedType::Symbol => "symbol".into(),
333	            CollectedType::StringLiteral(s) => format!("\"{}\"", s),
334	            CollectedType::NumberLiteral(n) => n.to_string(),
335	            CollectedType::BoolLiteral(b) => b.to_string(),
336	            CollectedType::Union(members) => members.iter().map(|m| m.to_raw_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" | "),
337	            CollectedType::Intersection(members) => {
338	                members.iter().map(|m| m.to_raw_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" & ")
339	            }
340	            CollectedType::Array(inner) => format!("{}[]", inner.to_raw_string()),
341	            CollectedType::Readonly(inner) => format!("readonly {}", inner.to_raw_string()),
342	            CollectedType::Named { name, args } if args.is_empty() => super::scope::unmarked(name).to_string(),
343	            CollectedType::Named { name, args } => {
344	                format!(
345	                    "{}<{}>",
346	                    super::scope::unmarked(name),
347	                    args.iter().map(|a| a.to_raw_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", ")
348	                )
349	            }
350	            CollectedType::TypeOf(name) => format!("typeof {}", name),
351	            CollectedType::KeyOf(inner) => format!("keyof {}", inner.to_raw_string()),
352	            CollectedType::AtFile { inner, .. } => inner.to_raw_string(),
353	            CollectedType::IndexedAccess { obj, key } => {
354	                format!("{}[{}]", obj.to_raw_string(), key.to_raw_string())
355	            }
356	            CollectedType::TemplateLiteral(parts) => format!(
357	                "`{}`",
358	                parts
359	                    .iter()
360	                    .map(|p| match p {
361	                        CollectedType::StringLiteral(s) => s.to_string(),
362	                        other => format!("${{{}}}", other.to_raw_string()),
363	                    })
364	                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
365	                    .join("")
366	            ),

421	            CollectedType::Undefined => serde_json::json!("undef"),
422	            CollectedType::Any => serde_json::json!("any"),

424	            CollectedType::Unknown => serde_json::json!("unknown"),
425	            CollectedType::Void => serde_json::json!("void"),
426	            CollectedType::BigInt => serde_json::json!("bigint"),
427	            CollectedType::Symbol => serde_json::json!("symbol"),

439	                    serde_json::json!("NaN")

454	            CollectedType::Union(members) => serde_json::json!({

523	                serde_json::json!({

532	            // Mapped: {"mapped": {p, k, v, o}}

534	                "mapped": {

2	export const SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION = 4

4	/** Returns `output` once its `schemaVersion` is the supported one and throws otherwise. Output without a version predates it. */
5	export function assertSchemaVersion<T extends { schemaVersion?: number }>(output: T, what: string): T {
6	  const version = output.schemaVersion ?? 1
7	  if (version !== SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION) {
8	    throw new Error(
9	      `The ${what} has schema version ${version}, and the oracle reads version ${SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION}. ` +
10	        'Run it with a caliper-docgen binary of the same release.',
11	    )
12	  }
13	  return output
14	}
